title: Proof-Carrying Contracts for Task-Preserving Power-System Model Transformation
description: Research code and evidence package for task-bound proof-carrying contracts and controlled power-grid model-transformation experiments, including N-1 contingency analysis, AC optimal power flow, DC security-constrained optimal power flow, and CGMES interoperability checks.
